title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for routine care.

History of Present Illness
Patient presents for routine follow-up. The patient's estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) indicates stage 1 kidney function. The patient also has a history of hypertension, which requires ongoing management. The patient reports no acute changes in symptoms since the last visit.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Amlodipine 5 mg daily

Exam
Vitals: BP 138/84 mmHg, HR 76 bpm, Temp 98.6°F. Physical exam is stable. Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally. Cardiovascular exam reveals regular rate and rhythm with no murmurs noted.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 1.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medications. Monitor blood pressure closely, given the history of hypertension. Recheck labs in 3 months to reassess kidney function parameters related to stage 1 status. Patient educated on dietary sodium restrictions. Follow up as scheduled.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
